notes.title: Achievements & AI - 0.4.0 Update AKA AA Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Tankers![/h3]

It took some time, but finally we have added bots to the game. It wasn't easy to create AI good enough to drive walls and fight in air combat, but I think we managed. Feel free to test it out and give us feedback on the [url=https://discord.gg/xvF6XZUaNn]discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1679800/discussions/]forums[/url]! 

There are 3 difficulty options for AI, you can also choose how many bots will be in the round. Fun fact: I think the max amount of AI is set to 99, although we recommend no more than 7 bots. If you have a powerful PC and feel confident, you can try more, but if anything happens, that's on you!

And as for the second part of the update.... we've added not 10, not even 25, but [b]50[/b] Achievements. 
2 of them are hidden, only tip I will give you that one of them you can get during the game and second one in menu.

On top of all that, we also prepared a special discount for this update [b]-35%[/b].

[h2]Patch notes 0.4.0[/h2]

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] AI. You can set bots amount and difficulty in game mode settings.
[*] 50 Achievements. You can find full list of achievements on Steam.
[*] Physical recoil of whole tank when player shoots.
[*] Labels of buttons, settings etc. change color to white when selected.
[/list]
[h3]Changed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Halved turret rotation speed.
[*] Updated discord link.
[*] Small tweaks on arenas.
[*] Changed color of the insides (sheets) of books on Toyroom to look more like paper.
[*] Updated version of networking system.
[*] Changed size of first player item in scoreboard
[*] Updated Font in some places
[/list]
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game mode settings show current value of settings instead of default.
[*] Input icon tip for power up use is now shown accordingly to what device player uses.
[*] The avatar in lobby list is no longer mirrored.
[*] The trees on Toyroom no longer overlap other objects.
[*] Other small fixes on Toyroom.
[*] Issues with burning from lava in online - duplicated deaths etc.
[*] Fixed issue in local mode when health bar was not updated when healed.
[*] Fixed issue with spawning inside Arena_b
[*] Fixed bug where you could not host or join lobby after playing local mode.
[/list]
[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] It’s not possible to unlock the achievements "Two birds with one stone" [i](Destroy 2 or more tanks with one bullet)[/i] and "1 to 14000605" [i](Destroy enemy projectile with your projectile)[/i] in [b]online[/b] mode right now. We are working on it. 
[*] Bots may not work correctly on Neon City. 
[/list]
[h3]Unreleased:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Although you can find in game folder files that suggest there is a mod support, there is not.  We were checking if mod support is possible. It is, maybe in future we will add it.
[/list]

That’s all for now! 

Limited Responsibility Team

notes.title: Patch 0.31
notes.content:
[h2]Patchnotes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Japanese font and characters. こんにちは
[*] Added Simplified Chinese font and characters 你好
[*] Disabled rich presence for discord - this caused infinite loading screen in online when discord was not running. 
[*] Fixed issue with steam presence when steam was not turn on - [strike][i]Pirate bay likes this[/i][/strike]
[*] Now you need to first select map before selecting game mode. User experience kinda suck because of that, so we probably update this in the future.
[*] 2 ramps on Arena_A are no longer black.
[*] Fixed some issues with respawning.
[*] Fixed issue with fire rate when player was shooting snowballs and normal bullets at the same time. [i]no more hypersonic shooting, I guess[/i]
[*] Selected option in dropdowns(ex. resolution setting) are now more visible.
[*] Updated credits names.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #01 - Murphy's law
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41036310/7ef35fda9fcb239fd75b633a00f4433d002d8610.png[/img]

[h3]Hi![/h3]
My name is Jerzy (you can call me by English equivalent - George, or by my [strike]gAmEr [/strike]nickname - XardoX) and I'm one of the devs of [b]Get Tanked![/b].

As you can guess from the title of this devlog - something went wrong. Yesterday, Steam Next Fest started, and we published a demo for our game. As every other indie game dev studio, we have been crunching for the last week to deliver the demo.  We [strike]delivered [/strike] actually decided without testing that the game works, and went to sleep.   So yea basically it didn't work, precisely online multiplayer.

[h2]The good news is that online multiplayer is now fixed.[/h2]

It should be playable, although you can still encounter issues. Especially if players have poor internet connection.

We are a small team, so every feedback we get is very valuable to us. If you would like to give us feedback about [b]Get Tanked![/b] or report a bug, you can use one of these forms:

[url=https://forms.gle/rn5Do2uRdTfazmWa8  style=button]Give us feedback[/url]
[url=https://forms.gle/XB7pGicWJvE3sBkC8 style=button] Report a bug or issue[/url]

I have plan for writing more detailed devlogs in future.


Jerzy



[h3]If you would like to support us, you can do it by adding [b]Get Tanked![/b] to your wishlist:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1679800/Get_Tanked/
